title: Socket head cap screw
summary: revolve, hex punch, modelled thread, size table
description: An ISO 4762 socket head cap screw, M3 to M12 in the standard's lengths, with a rolled thread, in black-oxide steel.
process: Cold heading, thread rolling, black oxide

difficulty.rationale: A punch built from a prism intersected with a cone, two coupled tables driving per-size choices, a closed form integrated over a hexagon, a modelled thread within the kernel's limits.

materials: Alloy steel, property class 12.9, black oxide
budget_exception: A modelled ISO thread is what makes the screw look real and costs most of its load time: 4.8 s at M8 x 30 on an idle machine, 9.0 s on one core (as on the web), 7 to 8 s for the longest screws threaded to the head (M8 x 35, M3 x 20) with other work running; a cosmetic thread costs 0.04 s but draws a smooth shank (F-004).

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 9 assertions; volume 2163.3 mm3 (+0.12 %), mass 16.98 g, socket 6.06 mm across flats, head 13 x 8 mm, modelled M8 x 1.25 thread, Length limited to each size's lengths; 16 size and length points checked; about 120 CLI calls. It took the table values from memory (s max 6.095 instead of 6.14 at M8) and needed a larger tip chamfer at M3 (F-006).
